name: namera
description: Scoped, revocable permissions for agent wallets on ERC-7579 smart accounts.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm docs:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm circular && pnpm test && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:docs && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm codegen:check && pnpm build && pnpm check:dist && pnpm api-snapshot --check && pnpm bundle-size && pnpm type-cost && pnpm pack:check
scripts.codegen: node scripts/bin.ts codegen --dir packages/sdk && node scripts/bin.ts codegen --dir packages/devnet && node scripts/bin.ts devnet bytecode
scripts.codegen:check: node scripts/bin.ts contracts generate --check && node scripts/bin.ts codegen --check --dir packages/sdk && node scripts/bin.ts codegen --check --dir packages/devnet && node scripts/bin.ts devnet bytecode --check
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && node scripts/bin.ts lint && pnpm --filter @namera-ai/contracts-sol lint
scripts.release:build: node scripts/bin.ts release strip-internal && pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm check:dist
scripts.release:version: changeset version && node scripts/bin.ts codegen --dir packages/sdk && pnpm install --ignore-scripts --no-frozen-lockfile && dprint fmt
